title.narrative: Readiness Actions for crisis affected communities in Amhara region (Bugna and Gazgibla Woredas) through prepositioning of supplies and provision of lifesaving health, nutrition and MPC services.

description.narrative: ltpgtASDEPO has prepositioned supplies and other necessary inputs for the proposed project and has also consulted the relevant clusters and EHF regarding to the relevance and necessity of the project implementation in Bugna and Gazgibla Woredas. Both Woredas have been labeled as locations with low or no partner presence and the communities are frequently exposed to crisis and are unable to meet their basic needs including health and nutrition related services. The response will be health, nutrition and MPC targeting conflict and drought affected communities in Bugna Woreda of North Wollo Zone and Gazgibla Woreda of Waghimra Zone. Through this project, ASDEPO will support the crisis affected communities in both Woredas who are in need of immediate lifesaving humanitarian support. The project integrates nutrition, health and MPC response. Protection will also be mainstreamed across the thematic sectors to prevent and respond GBV, Priority for PwD and vulnerable groups. The proposed activities and the proportion of budget allocation for each sector is based on the actual assessment findings and recommendations by the local government and clusters. ASDEPO has conducted prepositioning of supplies (by purchasing from market and through core pipeline) and preconditions for making quick response possible including recruiting project staffs to be deployed at earliest possible time. The proposed activities are designed and quantified based on the assessment findings from both Woredas and after consulting the relevant clusters. ASDEPO will implement the project activities in close consultation with the clusters especially regarding to the prepositioning of supplies. Key cross cutting areas will be meaningfully mainstreamed across the project activities and reasonable resource is allocated for cross cutting activities. The project will be implemented in close collaboration and complementarity among the organizations operating in the targeted location and the government stakeholders. ASDEPO will ensure proper monitoring and evaluation on activities to inform program management decisions with evidence from the field. Government counterparts will also conduct joint monitoring sessions periodically. ASDEPO is active in the cluster system at national and sub-national level. The coordination and reporting of project activities to the donor and the clusters via Activity info will be strengthened. The project duration initially was 8 months but it has now revised to be around 10 months considering that a significant number of months have elapsed without activating a single project. Even though the total project period is around 10 months the specific time allocated for implementation of project activities in both Woredas is not more than 6 months. The total budget of the project is 1,000,000 USD but an amount of 5,602.68 USD is not dedicated for any activity and stated as remaining from the allocated budget for RRM intervention. The project will directly reach 63,587 people in need in Bugna and Gazgibla Woredas of which 59% are female and 31% are children. lt/pgt
